_written: 2026-11-02, while AlphaGenome scoring was running and before any AlphaGenome score or new correlation was viewed. Exploratory; for choosing grant figures, not for claims of significance.
unit: designed SNV (633); one value per SNV per measure from evidence.tsv
statistic: Spearman rho with 95% bootstrap CI (2,000 resamples of SNVs, seed 20261102) and permutation-free asymptotic P; BH across all pairs listed here; n reported per pair

functional_vs_functional: MPRA vs local inaccessibility within 10 bp (HepG2)
HepG2 vs HEK293T local inaccessibility (HEK SNVs with >= 3 clones)
HepG2 element-wide shift vs HEK293T far inaccessibility (HEK SNVs with >= 3 clones)
predictor_vs_functional: AlphaGenome DNase (HepG2) vs local inaccessibility (expect negative)
AlphaGenome DNase (HepG2) vs nucleosome-size change (expect negative)
AlphaGenome LDLR RNA (HepG2) vs nucleosome-size change
AlphaGenome SP-family ChIP (HepG2) vs nucleosome-size change

clinical_separation: for each score: AUROC ClinVar P/LP (8 SNVs) vs B/LB (6 SNVs), with the direction fixed so that loss of expression / gain of protection counts as pathogenic-like; descriptive only (n tiny); also the score of each P/LP and B/LB SNV listed
hek_rule: HEK values used only for SNVs with >= 3 clones; never pooled or overlaid with HepG2
